text:
maya (devex): Quick heads-up: customers on older SDKs reporting weird quota spikes after the new routing-policy rollout. Dashboard shows increased per-route token burn for some tenants.

lee (eng-platform): which header variant are they sending? We switched to structured routing header last week.

rishi (sdk-ts): TS SDK v3.1.0 emits `x-redwood-route` kebab-case. Some internal proxies normalize header casing to Title-Case -> `X-Redwood-Route`, which our ingestion client treats as a separate key.

emily (sdk-go): go-sdk v1.9 introduced automatic batching by default; that shouldn't affect route attribution but might change token distribution across windows. Are the spikes real or just UI aggregation quirk?

nate (console): UI shows a new aggregation dimension `route_key` and it's not canonicalizing header variants. We're grouping by raw header string. That will produce duplicate rows when header formatting differs.

maya (devex): customers see multiple rows for same logical route and think they're over-consuming. We need a short-term mitigation and a longer-term contract.

lee (eng-platform): mitigation options: 1) ingestion normalization (lowercase canonical header + parse structured payload), 2) console canonicalization (map variant headers to single route id), 3) require SDKs to use canonical header (coord rollout). I'd prefer ingestion normalization as it's least disruptive.

rishi (sdk-ts): we can push a patch to TS SDK to emit `X-Redwood-Route` Title-Case to match proxies, but that'll be another release. Also: we added `priority` field in the structured header which some integrators set to string vs number, creating different route fingerprints.

emily (sdk-go): Go SDK can add explicit route fingerprinting helper util to ensure stable keys across versions. But customers pinned to older versions won't benefit.

nate (console): short-term: I'll change console to collapse rows with equivalent parsed route ids (best-effort). That buys time while ingestion changes land.

infra-bot: ingest-normalize job scheduled (job-789) at 2024-08-15T14:30Z :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

maya (devex): also need communications: small blurb on status page + guidance for SDK owners. I'll draft a note "Route attribution artifacts — investigating".

lee (eng-platform): long-term: formalize header contract: exact header name/casing, structured fields types (shard:int priority:string), and a stable route_id derivation algorithm. We'll add to API spec and mark for breaking-change window.

rishi (sdk-ts): agreed. I'll PR a migration guide for TS clients showing examples and an automatic shim:```
// ts-sdk example
client.request({route:{shard:3, priority:'low'}})
// sends canonical header `X-Redwood-Route: shard=3;priority=low`
```

emily (sdk-go): will include similar helper and a default-normalizer in 1.10 release notes.

nate (console): action items: console collapse (short-term), add `route_canonical` column in UI, and banner.

maya (devex): action items: status page blurb + customer outreach for pinned SDKs.

lee (eng-platform): infra will run ingest-normalize job, then we'll land schema change for route_source and canonical_route. Keep feature-flag for enforcement. We'll reconvene after ingest job completes. :+1:
